verdict.rationale: Runloop has a dedicated docs page for controlling devbox automatic shutdown and idle behaviors (runloop-docs-64). Its suspend/resume feature is described as pausing sandboxes to save state and costs (runloop-docs-27, runloop-docs-55), which together cover the core of the story. missing for 10: specific timeout parameters (keep-alive duration, idle threshold) are not shown, billing stopping on shutdown is only implied, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
